name: znetwork_dplay_refresh_service_provider_list
description: zNetwork_DPlay::RefreshServiceProviderList clears the provider vector, asks DirectPlay to enumerate connections, reports failure, and returns the provider count.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke covers the successful EnumConnections path; DirectPlay failure reporting is inherited from the accepted zNetwork_DPlay_ReportError boundary and remains covered by source review.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a0d0 validates ClearServiceProviderList, IDirectPlay4::EnumConnections slot 0x8c with g_zNetwork_AppGuid, zNetworkDPlay::EnumConnectionsCallback_AddServiceProviderInfo, g_RecoilApp_hWndMain, flags 0, ReportError line 0x6b on negative HRESULT, and provider count from g_zNetwork_ServiceProviderList begin/end.
The native smoke verifies the DirectPlay vtable call, application GUID forwarding, callback pointer, flags, provider append via callback, and returned provider count.
